What is the percentage increment in the population of village A in 2021 as compared to the population in the year 2018? (Correct up to two decimal place.)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Population of village A in 2018 = 12381

⇒ Population of village A in 2021 = 13256

⇒ Population increment = 13256 – 12381 = 875

⇒ Percentage increment in the population of village A = (875)/(12381) × 100 = 7.07%

**Therefore, there is a increment of 7.07% in village A from 2018 to 2021.**
